Whitehead SEO for organic ranking of the website.

The most important thing about a website is for your customers to find you. Most prospective customers enter a term (so-called keywords) in search engines and usually click on one of the first hits. If you rank high on the displayed search results, you are likely to attract new visitors and potential customers/clients.

Different techniques for search engine optimization

Next to the content, corresponding markups in the source code, internal links, the code quality, and the performance of the website are also valuable On-page factors. We support you in all aspects of search engine optimization and are happy to advise you on new and existing websites.

Off-page optimization is about increasing visibility through actions outside the website. Particularly important in search engine optimization are links that refer to your page from other pages. These are so-called backlinks. It is essential that we do not rush link building. If Google & Co suspect you of fraudulent behaviour, you might end up at the end of the results list. Activities on social networks, especially Google Plus and Facebook, also impact your search engine ranking.

Looking to rank website for local search engine in Houston, Bellaire, Cypress, Woodlands or other local areas, we can assist you. We can rank your business website in real quick.

Which data and information are required?

Collect all the details you think have contributed to the current issue. What actions, work, or changes preceded the error? Provide screenshots of errors and error messages.

The more you share with us, the faster and more effectively we can help you.

Alongside the error details, we also need the access details to your website. That includes WordPress Administrator access as well as FTP data. In some cases, we may also need access to your web host.

Process: What to do next?

Collect all information as described above. Then contact us using the form on the right. After submitting the form, you will receive separate emergency contact information where you can reach us outside our typical office hours.

Information
